run_preprocess_eval_files: run the script with --eval_files to preprocess Human3.6M dataset for evaluation
run_preprocess_train_files: run the script with --train_files to preprocess MPI-INF-3DHP, LSP, MPII, and COCO datasets
extract_h36m_dataset: extract Human3.6M dataset using h36m_extract with protocol 1 or 2 for evaluation
extract_mpi_inf_3dhp: extract MPI-INF-3DHP training data with images and static fits using mpi_inf_3dhp_extract
extract_coco_dataset: extract COCO dataset for training using coco_extract with openpose keypoints
